assumptions: Every result is exactly at lambda=0 and covers each full upstream exact-rational kappa bracket, not a midpoint or a unique root.
J=-W(u,partial_lambda u) is smooth through zeros of u. The runner does not evolve or divide by h on the open Q interval; it divides by u only at Q0 after a whole-band nonzero certificate.
For real kappa and positive x, K_(i*kappa)(x) is real by conjugation and order symmetry. Full complex balls are retained during finite quadrature.
DLMF 10.32.9 and cosh(t)>=1+t^2/2 give |K_(i*kappa)(x)|<=exp(-x)*sqrt(pi/(2x)), used only for the manual x>=64 tail.

The h(4) upstream boxes and independently evaluated K(4) balls are combined only as a positive J(4) magnitude sanity check against a coarse tail allowance. This is not a decomposition or propagation check; the endpoint J(Q0) certificate is the direct Green integral.
The two precision tiers use one locked backend and are consistency refinements, not independent implementations.

At a zero of the finite-Q0 lambda-zero proxy the ratio partial_lambda F_0/u(Q0) is normalization invariant, but it is not an eigenvalue slope for the declared raw-C extension: Gamma_1 is a minus-end Wronskian limit and its equality with u_Q(Q0) was pinned only at zero energy. The standalone amplitude, declared-extension derivative and all root velocities remain null.

ball_checks.statement: The outward balls certify 0<x0<1.5<2<4<8<16<X=32<xplus, so the six finite positive-real integration subsegments and the manual x>=X tail are ordered before the separately reconstructed plus endpoint.
The outward-rounded Arb parameter interval covers the exact-rational full upstream root bracket.
The full kappa-band K_(i*kappa)(x0) ball is real and excludes zero, so only the endpoint quotient h(Q0)=J(Q0)/u(Q0)^2 is permitted.

Using the exact real-valuedness theorem, the pinned h(4) box times the independently evaluated real u(4)^2 reconstructs a finite positive J(4) magnitude sentinel; this is not a Qplus-to-Q0 decomposition check.

The sum of six fixed finite acb.integral enclosures has an imaginary interval containing zero and a strictly positive real enclosure on the full band; exact real-valuedness is supplied separately by Bessel conjugation and order symmetry, and no h quotient occurs on this path.

The DLMF majorant bounds the full x>=X endpoint Green tail, while the independently reconstructed J(4) magnitude is below that coarse allowance; this is only a non-contradiction scale sentinel, not a transport equality.

certified_calculation.finite_Q0_proxy_scope: At a zero of F_0=u_Q(Q0), partial_lambda F_0/u(Q0)=-h(Q0); this is not a declared raw-C extension derivative or root velocity.
certified_calculation.method_scope: direct exact Green-integral endpoint construction, not numerical propagation of the upstream Qplus datum
certified_calculation.next_mathematical_gap: declare and validate a nonzero-lambda minus-end boundary functional before treating any finite-Q0 proxy derivative as an extension eigenvalue slope

root_bracket_rows.finite_Q0_proxy_conditional_at_root: partial_lambda F_0/u(Q0)=-h(Q0) only if F_0=u_Q(Q0)=0; not a declared-extension lambda derivative or eigenvalue slope

declared_conventions.conditional_finite_Q0_proxy_identity: if the finite-Q0 lambda-zero proxy F_0(kappa)=u_Q(Q0;kappa)=0, then partial_lambda F_0/u(Q0)=-J(Q0)/u(Q0)^2=-h(Q0); this is not identified with the declared raw-C Gamma_1(lambda) extension characteristic away from lambda=0
declared_conventions.execution: exact SymPy identities plus python-flint/Arb Bessel balls and finite acb.integral on six predetermined positive-real subsegments; no ODE solve, root solve, finite difference, Riccati h evolution or unbounded numerical quadrature
declared_conventions.plus_tail_magnitude_sanity: J(Qplus)=u(Qplus)^2*h(Qplus), reconstructed only as a positive smooth-Wronskian scale sentinel and not as a Qplus-to-Q0 decomposition check
declared_conventions.quadrature_variable: x in the fixed positive-real subdivision [x0,1.5],[1.5,2],[2,4],[4,8],[8,16],[16,32]

exact_checks.statement: J=-W(u,v)=u^2*h is smooth even where the quotient h is undefined.
The smooth flux obeys J_Q=-A_lambda*u^2 and is propagated without a Riccati quotient.
J scales by c(0)^2 under a lambda-dependent amplitude rescaling, while h=J/u^2 is invariant.
The exponential factor in the analytic Green tail has exact antiderivative exp(-2X)/2.
At a zero of the finite-Q0 proxy F_0=u_Q(Q0), endpoint evaluation gives W(u,v)=u(Q0)*partial_lambda F_0; this does not identify the proxy with the declared extension away from lambda=0.

primary_sources.not_used_for: nonzero-lambda transport, an endpoint amplitude F_lambda, root uniqueness, spectral data or RAQ
primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, modified-Bessel order symmetry, derivative recurrence and integral representation, sections 10.27, 10.29 and 10.32
primary_sources.used_for: the exact lambda-zero K representation, endpoint derivative formula, reality for imaginary order on positive x, and the K integral-representation tail majorant

primary_sources.not_used_for: the Green/Wronskian identity or any raw-C operator conclusion
primary_sources.source: Fredrik Johansson, Arb: Efficient Arbitrary-Precision Midpoint-Radius Interval Arithmetic

primary_sources.not_used_for: unbounded numerical quadrature or treating precision repeats as independent validation
primary_sources.source: python-flint acb complex-ball integration and special-function interface
primary_sources.used_for: locked rigorous finite acb.integral enclosures of the smooth Bessel-square Green density

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The direct Green integral constructs only the smooth Wronskian endpoint and never evolves h=u^{-2}J through an interior zero of u.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: J=-W(u,partial_lambda u)=u^2h and J_Q=-A_lambda*u^2 on the declared lambda-zero Bessel fiber

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The manually added x>=64 tail is bounded by pi*exp(-2X)/(4*sqrt(C*X)); no unbounded numerical quadrature is used.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: x>0, kappa real, |cos(kappa t)|<=1 and cosh(t)>=1+t^2/2
theorem_guards.theorem: DLMF 10.32.9 integral representation and Gaussian majorant

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: Finite integral values are rigorous complex-ball enclosures over full kappa bands; same-backend tiers are not independent implementations.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: finite positive-real path, callback cap, unconditional Re(x)>0 rejection, and sqrt analytic flag

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: K_(i*kappa)(x) is exactly real; the executable complex enclosures must contain zero in their imaginary parts, after which real-part squares are used for endpoint magnitude and quotient bounds.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: x>0 and kappa is real on every full parameter band

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The conditional relation for the finite-Q0 lambda-zero proxy is not a declared-extension derivative, eigenvalue slope or root velocity.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The declared raw-C Gamma_1 is a minus-end Wronskian limit and its equality with u_Q(Q0) was pinned only at lambda=0

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: No raw h trajectory, nonzero-lambda transport, F_lambda amplitude, declared extension derivative, root velocity, m-function, spectrum, RAQ, physics or TOE conclusion follows.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: Only lambda=0 five-bracket smooth Green boxes are emitted
